description: This Java class 'PackingSession' manages the packing process within an order shipment system, including creating shipments, packages, managing packing lines, calculating weights, and handling related events and inventory reservations.

classes.name: ItemDisplay
classes.description: Inner class representing a display item with order item details, quantity, and product ID, used for summarizing packed items.

methods.name: addOrIncreaseLine
methods.description: Adds a new line or increases quantity for a specific product in the packing session, handling inventory reservations and creating packing lines.

methods.name: findLine
methods.description: Finds a specific packing session line based on order, product, inventory, and package identifiers.

methods.name: createPackLineItem
methods.description: Creates a new packing line item, updating package weight and sequence as needed.

methods.name: checkLineForAdd
methods.description: Checks if a reservation can hold the requested quantity, returning a code indicating whether to create a new line, update existing, or do nothing.

methods.name: addItemInfo
methods.description: Adds item information to the session, aggregating quantities for duplicate items.

methods.name: getItemInfos
methods.description: Returns the list of item display summaries.

methods.name: getPackingSessionLinesByPackage
methods.description: Returns a map of package sequence IDs to their respective packing lines, sorted by package sequence.

methods.name: clearItemInfos
methods.description: Clears the item info summaries.

methods.name: getShipmentId
methods.description: Returns the current shipment ID associated with the packing session.

methods.name: getLines
methods.description: Returns the list of all packing lines.

methods.name: nextPackageSeq
methods.description: Increments and returns the next package sequence number.

methods.name: getCurrentPackageSeq
methods.description: Returns the current package sequence number.

methods.name: getPackedQuantity
methods.description: Calculates total packed quantity for specified order, product, inventory, and package.

methods.name: createShipment
methods.description: Creates a shipment record based on current packing session details.

methods.name: issueItemsToShipment
methods.description: Issues packed items to the created shipment, updating shipment items accordingly.

methods.name: runEvents
methods.description: Runs registered packing events with specified event code.

methods.name: updateShipmentRouteSegments
methods.description: Updates shipment route segments with total weight and UOM.

methods.name: setShipmentToPacked
methods.description: Marks the shipment as packed.

methods.name: setPicklistToPicked
methods.description: Updates the picklist status to 'PICKED' and handles related logic.

methods.name: setPickerOnPicklist
methods.description: Assigns a picker role to the picklist.

methods.name: getTotalWeight
methods.description: Calculates total weight of all packages.

methods.name: getShipmentCostEstimate
methods.description: Estimates shipment cost based on various parameters and shippable info.
